description: DeFi Cover Claim Adjudicator — Predicts whether a DeFi cover claim (Nexus Mutual or any provider's wording) will be approved and for how much. Reads the wording, postmortems and the claimant's transactions, quantifies net token loss with Chainlink prices at the loss block, maps facts to covered events, exclusions and conditions with verbatim verified clauses, cites similar past claims, and returns verdict.action (FILE / FILE_WI

claimDate.description: ISO 8601 date the claim is (to be) filed; default now.

claimant.description: Address that suffered the loss (the Impacted Account).

claimedLoss.description: Loss the claimant asserts, in cover-asset units. Used for the payout only when no on-chain loss can be established; always reported as unverified.

amount.description: Cover amount in units of the cover asset.

asset.description: Cover asset symbol, e.g. ETH, USDC, DAI, cbBTC.

deductible.description: Overrides any deductible found in the wording. Amount in cover-asset units; percentages 0-100.

basis.description: from_loss (default, Nexus clause 6): min(loss - deductible, cover). from_capped_loss: min(loss, cover) - deductible.

occurredAt.description: ISO 8601 time the loss event began, if known.

transactions.description: Transactions in which the claimant lost (or deposited, or recovered) funds.

wording.description: The cover wording: a Nexus Mutual product (id or name), a URL (HTML or PDF), or pasted text. At least one.

productName.description: Nexus Mutual product or product-type name, e.g. "Single Protocol Cover".

text.description: Wording text; overrides the other fields.

url.description: Public URL of any provider's wording (PDF, HTML or text).

name: cover-claim
